title: Staged Utility Topic Catalog
body_html:
Staged Utility Topic Catalog

Canonical folder topic: utility

Subtopics

  • utility.preferences - preference relations and axiom statements.
  • utility.lotteries - lotteries, vNM axioms, expected utility, and representation targets.
  • utility.affine - positive affine transformations and uniqueness.
  • utility.risk - risk neutrality and related utility properties.

Boundary

Put game-specific payoff or equilibrium concepts under the owning game topic.
